frame.body: origin pin-axis midpoint; clear +Z, tapped -Z, bow -X; bow plane XZ
frame.pin: origin threaded tip; +Z toward head; tab broad face XZ, cross-hole axis Y

thread.phase_field: q = (z_body - z_seated)/pitch - (azimuth - start_angle)/(2*pi); crests at integer q
thread.advance_relation: pin turned by theta advances by theta/(2*pi)*pitch
thread.sign_convention: theta positive clockwise looking down from head toward tip; advances toward body -Z
thread.kinematics: z_tip = z_seated + advance_remaining; R_pin = Rz(+2*pi*advance_remaining/pitch); equivalently delta_z = pitch*delta_spin_about_+Z/(2*pi)
thread.profile: ISO 60 degree axial flanks; external P/8 flat crests and truncated roots; internal basic minor plus radial clearance

notes: Provisional 20 mm diameter / 2.5 mm pitch; manufacturer and thread standard not identified.
Use OBJ in MuJoCo: explicit independent per-corner normals keep 60-degree thread edges crisp. STL is geometry-only fallback.
Default visuals are helical; original plain visual meshes retained as *_plain.*.
Collision meshes and manifest are frozen byte-for-byte; only visual geometry was changed.
No billed inference calls, hardware or simulation-server operations.
